policy.label: Sourced claims
policy.note: every comparison cites a published figure

constraints.label: Brand voice
constraints.detail: Plain, specific, no superlatives. A draft that reads like SEO filler does not ship, whatever it ranks for.

constraints.label: Canonical URL structure
constraints.detail: /guides/{topic} for content, /products/{sku} for PDPs. No new path patterns, no parameterised duplicates.

constraints.label: No auto-publish
constraints.detail: Realify drafts briefs and copy. A human editor approves and publishes every page, always.

constraints.label: No competitor scraping
constraints.detail: Comparisons cite the competitor’s own published figures or say nothing. Nothing inferred from their pages.
